api/auth.title: Authentication
api/auth.description: Handles user credential validation and JWT token issuance.

api/devices.title: Devices
api/devices.description: Manages physical scanner station devices. Also provides the station-specific login endpoint.

api/health.title: Health Check
api/health.description: Infrastructure endpoint for load balancers, monitoring systems, and uptime checks.

api/intro.title: API Overview
api/intro.description: This document covers every REST API endpoint exposed by the Express server (server/).

api/master-data.title: Master Data
api/master-data.description: Lookup tables for parts, machines, categories, models, customers, and factories. All follow the same CRUD pattern.

api/privileges.title: QR Privileges
api/privileges.description: Controls which QR codes each scanner station is allowed to scan. When a station has no privilege rows it operates in open access mode. Once any QR is assigned it switches to restricted mode.

api/qr.title: QR Codes
api/qr.description: Core module for QR code generation, scanning (SCAN IN/OUT toggle), and stock management.

api/scans.title: Scan Records
api/scans.description: Access to raw scan event records. The primary scan toggle is handled by POST /api/qr/process.

api/stock.title: Stock
api/stock.description: Direct access to the stock table (current inventory levels per QR batch).

api/stock-analytics.title: Stock Analytics
api/stock-analytics.description: Production analytics per machine/part, used for the TV dashboard and shift-level monitoring.

api/tasks.title: Tasks
api/tasks.description: Audit log of system events (QR creation, scan in/out, etc.). Tasks are created automatically by QR and scan handlers - this endpoint is read-only for reporting.

api/users.title: Users
api/users.description: CRUD operations for admin/operator user accounts.
